This is a list of Merits and Flaws in the Storyteller System.

==Merits==

==='''<u>One</u>'''===
'''''Ability Aptitude''''' You are particularly gifted with one Ability.

'''Ambidextrous''' Most people are good with one hand, but your character is equally good with both.

==='''<u>Variable</u>''' ===

|}

==Flaws==

==='''<u>One</u>'''===
'''Addiction''' You are addicted to a substance and suffer without it.

==='''<u>Two</u>'''===
'''Blind''' You cannot see and suffer the usual penalties.
